_readme: The addresses the legacy site published, and the page that replaced each.
Built on 2026-11-05 from content/_livejsonld.json (the capture of the
live legacy site) joined to the current pages on the SKU. The same SKU
is the same product at two addresses, so the map is a join, not a guess.
Every one of these addresses was published by the legacy site and may
still be in a search engine's index. A 301 hands the address and its
history to the page that replaced it; a 404 throws the history away and
leaves the engine with a dead address it has to re-discover.
The nginx rules that serve them live in the site's vhost. scripts/
check_legacy_redirects.py checks both this map and the live answers.
